reviews.text:
We noticed on an old invoice that the landscape company we used in 2014 had  used Cedar Shade to build our front yard pergola. The quality of that pergola is outstanding, therefore in 2025 we decided to contact Cedar Shade directly to have them design a garden arbor for our back yard. When I texted Phil on a Sunday he responded within minutes, we made an appointment to meet and talk about what I had envisioned. Every call and every text was answered immediately. We worked so well together. I have only positive words that I can say about Phil and his company Cedar Shade. The  quality of our backyard arbor is more than I ever dreamed. It is truly Pinterest worthy and a 10 star review is not enough. I would not change one thing about this experience. Thank you Phil and crew for giving us the wonderful experience of working with your team, and we are so grateful for the beauty and quality of this project.
I am a gardener and everything turned out  more than I was expecting. .  Phil, dealing with you and your team was a real pleasure. Thank you to your  team of designers and installers.
reviews.author: Sherry Bieker

reviews.text: Excellent job by Phil and his crew! The plans that he put together were top notch which made it easy to get approved by the HOA. The quality of work is great and pricing is very reasonable. I definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: J

reviews.text: Cedar Shade did an excellent job on our back porch. We had tongue in groove added underneath to an existing roof that Cedar Shade had built a few years ago. Jacob, Rueben, and John were very polite and professional and very easy to work with. They did an outstanding job explaining every step that was taken to insure that the finished project was just what we were wanting. Thank you to Phil and his crew for a job well done!
reviews.author: randy

reviews.text:
What an amazing crew and experience.  My wife and I did a lot of research and planning to have the ultimate pergola or as my kids now call it "our pavilion "    Our choice came down to "you get what you pay for"

After searching online and looking at metal and wood options it came down to where can we go where we can trust in what we are getting

After calling Cedar Shade Company Phil came by our home to see what there was to work with and with his crews outstanding skills we now have a breathtaking backyard oasis

There is no other choice  An amazing group of people
reviews.author: Steven Smaney

reviews.text: We contacted Cedar Shade as they came highly recommended from our pool builder. We had a great experience working with Phil and his team to get the perfect Pergola built for our backyard. From the initial consult and design to the installation and clean up, these guys are the best. Will definitely use them again for future projects!
reviews.author: Anthony Nolasco

reviews.text: Awesome to work with.  Collaborated on the design.  Brought out several stain swatches.  Done in 2 days.  No mess left behind.  Very happy with the result.
reviews.author: Sherry Wiiliams

reviews.text: Excellent service and follow up.  They have good engineering services and the arbor was beautiful!
reviews.author: Barry Johnson

reviews.text: Cedar Shade was great to work with! Excellent work, great communication! I love my pergola!
reviews.author: Stacy Wells

data.summary: The 8 Google reviews are highly authentic in content, with specific details, varied writing, and credible project stories. However, the perfect 5.0 score with no negative reviews and a very low total volume for a company operating since at least 2014 is a minor red flag. There is no evidence of review manipulation in the text, but the sample is small and overly positive.
fake_signals: Low review volume (8) for a company with a long history (since at least 2014)
All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback

positive_evidence: Mention of a pergola built in 2014 with 'outstanding quality' still noted in 2025, implying longevity

authentic_signals: Specific project details (pergola, arbor, tongue and groove)
Mention of crew names (Phil, Jacob, Rueben, John)
Mention of multi-year relationship and referral from pool builder
Specific details about HOA approval and stain swatches
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has a rating, which is perfect. No other platforms have ratings to compare against, so no discrepancy can be assessed.
